title: Satin Brass Towel Ring, 6-Inch Diameter, Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Bathroom Towel Holder, Allied Brass
description: Towel ring for bathroom use, 6 inches / 6-inch / 6in diameter, round wall-mounted design for hand towels and decorative towels in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass. Solid brass construction with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look; wall mount installation saves space. Use as a towel ring, towel holder, or bathroom towel hanger near the sink or vanity. Overall product dimensions: 6 x 6 x 6 inches (LxHxW) with 2-inch projection; supports up to 10 lb weight capacity. Includes towel ring and all installation hardware; assembly required: false. Contemporary style from the Foxtrot collection—ideal for matching Foxtrot, textured bathroom hardware, designer bath accessories, designer bathroom hardware, and statement bath accessories. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Foxtrot collection.
